test_load_pool: test the load_pool function to load a credential pool for a given provider name from auth.json
test_CredentialPool_select: test the CredentialPool.select method to choose the next available credential using fill_first or round_robin strategy
test_CredentialPool_mark_exhausted_and_r: test the CredentialPool.mark_exhausted_and_rotate method to mark the current credential exhausted and rotate to the next one
test_CredentialPool_try_refresh_current: test the CredentialPool.try_refresh_current method to refresh the OAuth token of the current pool entry
test_CredentialPool_acquire_lease: test the CredentialPool.acquire_lease and release_lease methods to manage soft concurrent leases on pool credentials
test_get_custom_provider_pool_key: test the get_custom_provider_pool_key function to map a base_url to a custom pool key like custom:together.ai
test_list_custom_pool_providers: test the list_custom_pool_providers function to return sorted custom pool keys that have credential entries in auth.json
